name: Holiday Pecan Pie (Whole Nuts & High-Fructose Corn Syrup — Flare Avoid)
whyItWorks: Flagged as a strict holiday Avoid: packed with sharp whole pecan halves and a concentrated corn-syrup/butter filling that scrapes inflamed mucosa and draws osmotic water into the bowel.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Always pass on Pecan Pie and choose Pumpkin Pie, Banana Cream Pie, or Peeled Apple Pie instead.
